Update the failover timings in the shared policy.

Rejected as a whole when the result would break the renew-vs-TTL or
poll-vs-TTL rules, with the reason as the message — the validation already
explains what the maximum is, so the UI does not need to duplicate the rule.

Timing changes apply to the loops on their next restart of HA (or the next
Grid start); the lease TTL a running node advertises is set when it engages.
